specification.problem: Full n-qubit state tomography via a complete set of 2^n+1 mutually unbiased bases, each realized by a Clifford circuit U_k (H, S/Z-type, CZ gates) before computational-basis measurement, followed by identity-subtracted linear inversion.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest instance n=3 (qubit cap n, no ancillas, no black box). Generic MUB tomography structure and reconstruction formula are specified; the explicit CZ graph, local gates and generator W of the paper are NOT given in the abstract and must be supplied or searched by the builder (e.g. by verifying the MUB condition numerically). The n=4 case, the entanglement-class classification and the circuit-resource analysis are outside scope.

symbols.meaning: Clifford circuit mapping basis k to computational basis; U_0=I
basic generator built from H and CZ (plus local phase gates)
j-th vector of basis k, U_k^\dagger|j\rangle
probability of outcome j when measuring in basis k
outcome integer, j=sum_i b_i 2^i with b_i from qubit i (little-endian; Qiskit key bits[::-1][i])

equations.label: MUB condition
equations.description: Defining property of the d+1 mutually unbiased bases that the circuits U_k must satisfy; can be checked numerically in simulation.
equations.abstract_quote: cyclic generation of mutually unbiased bases
equations.justification: The abstract refers to complete sets of mutually unbiased bases, whose standard definition is this overlap condition.

equations.label: Cyclic generation
equations.latex: U_0=I,\quad U_k=U_1 W^{k-1}\ \text{or equivalently basis } k \text{ obtained by } W^{k}\text{ applied to a Hadamard-type basis},\quad k=1,\dots,d
equations.description: Bases beyond the computational one are produced by repeated application of one generator W. The exact indexing and the order of W's action are an assumption and must be fixed by verifying eq_1.
equations.justification: The abstract states cyclic generation with a generator using H and controlled-phase gates, but not the exact formula or the order of W.
assumptions: W built from H, CZ and S/Z gates
Cyclic structure of period 2^n+1 on non-computational bases, or an equivalent one
Specific graph and local gates not given in the abstract

equations.label: Born probabilities
equations.description: Outcome distribution after applying U_k and measuring all qubits in the computational basis.
equations.justification: Born rule with the definition |psi_{k,j}> = U_k^dagger|j>.
assumptions: Exact statevector probabilities or many shots

equations.label: Linear-inversion reconstruction
equations.description: Reconstruction from MUB probabilities; follows because the MUB projectors form a 2-design (sum_k sum_j P_{kj} tr(P_{kj} rho) = rho + I for tr rho=1).
equations.justification: Well-known MUB tomography identity for complete sets of d+1 MUBs.

equations.label: Parameter count
equations.description: Each of the 2^n+1 bases gives 2^n-1 independent numbers, matching the free parameters of rho, so the measurement count is minimal.
equations.abstract_quote: The number of measurements necessary to perform the quantum state reconstruction of a system of qubits grows exponentially with the number of constituents
equations.justification: Counting inference; the abstract mentions only exponential growth, and the exact count follows from standard background.

registers.name: q
registers.role: system qubits holding the state rho, prepared by a given circuit, then rotated by U_k and measured; no ancillas

registers.name: c
registers.role: classical bits recording outcome j little-endian: bit i from qubit i

specification.initial_state: |0>^{\otimes n} followed by a given preparation circuit for the test state rho (pure or mixed, supplied by the task)

steps.description: Fix n=3 and choose a CZ graph and local gates for W so that the d+1 bases satisfy the MUB condition (verify numerically via the statevector/unitary of the circuits).
For each k=0..d build the circuit: state preparation, then U_k (k=0 is empty, k>=1 is W-based cyclic product from H, CZ, S/Z gates).
Obtain p_k(j) for all j from the computational-basis measurement (exact probabilities or counts), reading j little-endian from the counts key (last char is qubit 0).
Reconstruct rho using the identity-subtracted sum with |psi_{k,j}> = U_k^dagger|j> computed from the same circuits.

specification.measurement: Measure all n qubits in the computational basis after U_k for each k=0..2^n; measure(i,i) with outcome j=sum b_i 2^i.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Compute |psi_{k,j}> = U_k^dagger|j> from the circuit unitary, sum p_k(j)|psi_{k,j}><psi_{k,j}| over all k and j, subtract identity; optionally compare fidelity with the true state. No maximum-likelihood step.
assumptions: n=3 chosen as the smallest instance within the paper's n=3,4 scope
Builder must find W and the local gates itself; the abstract gives only that W uses H and controlled-phase gates
Exact probabilities or large-shot counts are available
missing_information: Explicit CZ graph, local gates and form of W for each entanglement class
Order of W and the exact indexing of cyclic bases
Which bases are separable versus entangled for n=3, 4
Circuit depth and gate counts per class
